summary: Added Share Profile modal feature to user settings page. Created beautiful modal matching design with social media sharing buttons (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram), URL copy functionality, and success message. Added share button click handlers for both provider and non-provider users. Implemented copy to clipboard with visual feedback, social media sharing functions, and proper modal open/close functionality with keyboard support (ESC key). Added Share Profile button in Edit Profile form section. All features tested and working perfectly with smooth animations and responsive design.
current_status: Share Profile modal feature fully implemented and ready for use. Modal opens on share icon click, displays success message, provides social sharing options, and includes URL copy functionality with visual feedback. All bugs fixed and features polished.
